title: Transformer-Based Models for Automatic Identification of Argument Relations: A Cross-Domain Evaluation
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmark measures the performance of transformer-based models on the task of identifying argument relations (support, attack, rephrase, no relation) in political and general debate corpora.
findings: The paper does not analyze any aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on argument relation mining in political and general debate corpora.
